title: Power Amplifier
text: Model narrowband power amplifier with memory, 1 input, 1 output; {Model}, {Coefficient matrix}, {Measured interval of PA data (s)} sets the sample time of measured input-output data and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Model
params.values: Model to design amplifier Memory polynomial (default) | Cross-term memory

params.name: Measured interval of PA data (s)
params.values: Sample time of measured input-output data 1e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
